caption:
How many people do you cook for? Comment the number.

A recipe for 6 and there are 2 of you? In WE.LIFE you adjust portions to the number of people, and the shopping list from your meal plan counts just what you need.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.
